subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should the shared Kubernetes manifest ship a fixed `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536` heap cap by default, or should Kubernetes heap tuning stay as optional operator guidance?
rationale: This PR changes a public deployment default with upgrade/operator impact, and code review can identify the risk but cannot choose the product policy for all Kubernetes users.

options.title: Ship the fixed cap after corrections
options.body: Accept the default 1536 MiB cap for the 2Gi sample manifest after the wording is corrected and redacted Kubernetes proof is added.

options.title: Make it optional guidance only
options.body: Document the heap-setting pattern without adding `NODE_OPTIONS` to the shared manifest, avoiding a new inherited runtime default.

options.title: Defer to broader heap work
options.body: Pause this PR and route Kubernetes tuning through the broader gateway heap/OOM configuration work if maintainers want one cross-platform policy.

recommendation.title: Ship the fixed cap after corrections
recommendation.body: Accept the default 1536 MiB cap for the 2Gi sample manifest after the wording is corrected and redacted Kubernetes proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Kubernetes install guide and manifests, making them the best available routing candidate for this deployment-surface choice.
